checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
tmp=Path("/tmp/miy-boundary-docs-consolidation-64z2sjfo")
baseline=json.loads((tmp/"baseline.json").read_text())
old=(tmp/"VALIDATION.md").read_text()
app=Path("docs/APP-BOUNDARIES.md").read_text()
stub=Path("docs/VALIDATION.md").read_text()
before_app=(tmp/"APP-BOUNDARIES.md").read_text()
def section(s,name):
    return s.split("## "+name+"\n",1)[1].split("\n## ",1)[0]
bv=lambda s: [l for l in s.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| BV-\d\d \|",l)]
old_bv=bv(old);new_bv=bv(app)
assert len(old_bv)==14 and old_bv==new_bv
assert not bv(stub)
rows=lambda s: [l for l in section(s,"기존 검증의 승계").splitlines() if l.startswith("|")][2:]
assert len(rows(old))==11 and rows(old)==rows(app)
assert section(old,"경계 인수")==section(app,"경계 인수").split("아래 BV ID와 통과 조건은 AB-01~08의 구현 완료를 판정하며, 문서 통합은 제품 구현·운영 검증이 아니다.\n",1)[1]
evidence=section(old,"증거와 판정").strip().split("\n\n",1)[0]
assert evidence in app
assert re.findall(r"```mermaid\n(.*?)```",before_app,re.S)==re.findall(r"```mermaid\n(.*?)```",app,re.S)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("links","scripts/check-doc-links.py")
links=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(links)
assert links.anchors(tmp/"VALIDATION.md",{}).issubset(links.anchors(Path("docs/VALIDATION.md"),{}))
changed=[];protected=0
for name,digest in baseline.items():
    p=Path(name)
    now=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() else None
    if now!=digest:changed.append(name)
    if name.startswith(("docs/archive/","docs/releases/")):
        assert now==digest, name
        protected+=1
hist=Path("docs/IMPLEMENTATION-RESULTS.md").read_text().split("## ",1)[1]
assert hashlib.sha256(hist.encode()).hexdigest()==(tmp/"implementation-results-body.sha256").read_text()
paths=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--name-only"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
assert all(n.startswith("docs/") or n in ("README.md","AGENTS.md") for n in paths)
for name in changed:
    p=Path(name)
    if p.suffix!=".md":continue
    fence=None
    for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
        match=re.match(r"^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})",line)
        if not match:continue
        marker=match.group(1)
        if fence is None:fence=marker
        elif marker[0]==fence[0] and len(marker)>=len(fence):fence=None
    assert fence is None, name
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","acceptanceRows":14,"inheritedRequirementRows":11,"legacyAnchors":len(links.anchors(tmp/"VALIDATION.md",{})),"mermaidBlocksUnchanged":2,"protectedArchiveAndEvidenceFiles":protected,"historicalResultBodyUnchanged":True,"changedDocsThisTask":changed},ensure_ascii=False))
